_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

place-and-time.text: A located photo or video carries a place and a time. Companion Atlas puts both on one map.

title-card.text: Companion Atlas draws your located memories on a globe, in time order.

the-globe.text: This is a bundled sample story, not anyone's memories. Each pin is a memory, a line joins the journey, and the timeline runs underneath.

flat-map.text: Switch to the flat map and the same story reads as a route.

scrapbook.text: Collect memories into a scrapbook. Without a Companion Memory connection you can still play the journey and download it as a story file.

what-ships.text: Today the viewer is what ships. It loads a story from a link, a local draft or Companion Memory, and works on offline imagery without a token. The processing server is still being built.

close.text: Companion Atlas, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
